snippet.title: Birdigo trailer | Thinky Direct 2025
snippet.description:
Build words and deploy game-changing cards in this roguelike deckbuilder from the creators of AlphaBirds™. Use savvy and strategy to guide your flock on their epic migration.

Check out this brand new trailer for Birdigo, from John August and Corey Martin, releasing later this year in 2025.

Birdigo in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/birdigo/

Birdigo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264170/Birdigo/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkgames.com/direct/
